annotations.title: Compare a 1099 contract with a W-2 salary

description: Compare a 1099 hourly contract with a W-2 salary offer, counting the extra self-employment tax, 401(k) match, health insurance and business expenses. Returns which pays more, by how much, and the break-even 1099 hourly rate. Same math as the auracalcs.com 1099 vs W-2 calculator. Estimate only.

billableHoursPerWeek.description: Billable hours per week on the contract. Defaults to 40.

businessExpenses.description: Business expenses as a contractor per year. Defaults to 0.

employer401kMatchPercent.description: Employer 401(k) match as a percent of salary. Defaults to 0.

employerHealthInsurance.description: Employer-paid health insurance per year. Defaults to 0.

paidDaysOff.description: Paid vacation and holiday days in the W-2 job. Defaults to 0.

weeksWorkedPerYear.description: Weeks worked per year on the contract. Defaults to 48, like the website.

name: compare_1099_vs_w2
